name: ADSP Form Service Integration
summary: Embed an ADSP form with live definition loading, validation, and submission.

properties.mode: 'mock' for prototyping without backend, 'live' for real submissions
properties.formServiceBaseUrl: Base URL of Form Service API (required for live mode)
properties.definitionId: Form definition ID from Form Service (required for live mode)
properties.accessToken: Bearer token for authenticated requests (required for live mode)

mockModeNotes: Mock mode allows rapid prototyping without Form Service setup
Define inline schemas to test form layouts
Switch to live mode when ready to connect to real backend
liveModeNotes: Form definition must exist in Form Service
Submissions are persisted and can trigger workflows
notes: To collect data, edit the dataSchema and uiSchema of mockDefinition. Do not hand-build form fields in the page with plain HTML, custom labels or custom error markup.
Reuse the common definitions (personFullName, postalAddressAlberta, email, phoneNumber, ...) by $ref before designing fields. Use schemaDefinitionTool to see their shape.
Call formExamplesTool for worked examples of controls, layouts, rules and validation, and rendererCatalogTool for uncertain field shapes.
After editing the definition, call builderFormSchemaValidate with both schemas and fix every error it reports.
A field shown or hidden by a rule must not be top-level required; use an if/then block for conditional required.
Mock mode: use plain enums for option lists. Data registers and file-urn upload need a live Form Service tenant.
Keep Apply.tsx as the renderer and keep the submit and confirmation flow; change them only when the user asks.
